final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_reb, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), bench AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net) AS b FROM per_order) SELECT AVG(p.avg_reb) AS avg_rebtotal, AVG(p.avg_net) AS avg_net_rate, AVG(p.avg_net - bench.b) AS avg_excess FROM per_order p, bench WHERE p.avg_net > bench.b
